tools.name: mask_text
tools.description: Replaces personal data in a text with labels such as ⟦PERSON_1⟧ and returns the masked text. The text is sent to Redactic in the EU for detection. The map that restores the values stays in this MCP server and is never returned. Pass the returned session_id to later calls of the same conversation so that the same person keeps the same label, and to restore_text. Keep the labels unchanged when you rewrite the text.

session_id.description: The session of an earlier mask_text call, to keep labels consistent.

detection_mode.description: How thoroughly the text is read. "accurate" (default) takes a second look at places, addresses and organisations. "fast" skips it and answers sooner.

regions.description: Countries of the document as ISO codes, for example ["IT","DE"]. Leave out to detect the country.

language.description: Language of the text as a two-letter code, as a hint.

types.description: Entity types to mask, for example ["PERSON","IBAN"]. Leave out for all types.

tools.name: restore_text
tools.description: Puts the original values back into a text that contains labels of a session, and writes the result to a file. Returns the path of the file, so the original values do not enter the conversation. The work is done on this computer; nothing is sent to Redactic.

output_path.description: Full path of the file to write. It must not exist yet. Default: a new file in the first allowed folder.

tools.name: mask_file
tools.description: Masks the personal data of a file (PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, text, image) and saves the masked copy next to the original as "<name> (masked)". The file is sent to Redactic in the EU for detection and deleted there once the copy is saved. Returns the path of the masked copy and a session_id for restore_file. The original file is not changed.

detection_mode.description: How thoroughly the text is read. "accurate" (default) takes a second look at places, addresses and organisations. "fast" skips it and answers sooner.

regions.description: Countries of the document as ISO codes, for example ["IT","DE"]. Leave out to detect the country.

language.description: Language of the text as a two-letter code, as a hint.

types.description: Entity types to mask, for example ["PERSON","IBAN"]. Leave out for all types.

tools.name: restore_file
tools.description: Puts the original values back into a masked text, Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx) file and saves the result as "<name> (restored)". The work is done on this computer; nothing is sent to Redactic. A masked PDF cannot be restored.

path.description: Full path of the file that contains labels.

session_id.description: The session_id returned by mask_file or mask_text.

tools.name: redact_file
tools.description: Removes the personal data of a PDF or an image for good and draws black boxes in its place, then saves the result as "<name> (redacted)" with its certificate. This cannot be restored. The file is sent to Redactic in the EU and deleted there once the result is saved. The original file is not changed.

path.description: Full path of the PDF or image.

blackout_images.description: Also black out every embedded picture, such as photos, signatures and logos.

detection_mode.description: How thoroughly the text is read. "accurate" (default) takes a second look at places, addresses and organisations. "fast" skips it and answers sooner.

regions.description: Countries of the document as ISO codes, for example ["IT","DE"]. Leave out to detect the country.

language.description: Language of the text as a two-letter code, as a hint.

types.description: Entity types to mask, for example ["PERSON","IBAN"]. Leave out for all types.

tools.name: check_file
tools.description: Looks inside a PDF or Word file for data that a reader does not see and a recipient can still extract: text under a covering shape, unapplied redactions, invisible text, document properties, older revisions, attachments, comments and tracked changes. Excerpts come back masked. The file is sent to Redactic in the EU and is not stored.

path.description: Full path of the PDF or .docx file.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Returns the plan of the Redactic workspace, the documents and text used this month, and the limits.
